subject: Urgent: prospect calendar overlap — need to compress or reassign demo

Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@solvecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to move tomorrow's demo — board prep conflict

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Quick heads-up: our exec team has tacked on an all-hands board prep meeting that conflicts with the time we had scheduled for the Redwood demo tomorrow (1/12 at 10:00 PT). I don't want to lose momentum on the POC timelines, but several stakeholders who were planning to attend will now be in the board prep.

Options we can do from our side:
- Move to Tue 1/12 1:00 PM PT (preferred)
- Keep tomorrow but compress to 30 minutes and focus just on the integration + perf numbers
- Or run the full walkthrough, but with your SE only (no execs) and record for us

I've attached the agenda (agenda_v2.pdf). Can you let me know what works? If you need a different SE for 1:00 PM PT, I can make that happen.

Thanks,
Dana

Director, Product 
SolveCorp

2) If you prefer a compressed session tomorrow, we can do 30 minutes focused on integration + perf; I'll skip the product deep-dive.

My preference: move to Tue 1/12 1:00 PM PT and loop in Marissa to cover procurement questions. If that works, I'll send an updated invite and attach a short one-sheet for the integration notes.

Proposed next step: you confirm Tue 1/12 1:00 PM PT or say "compress tomorrow" and we'll flip it.

—Karthik

- Can we make it 45 minutes (not full 60)? Execs want the integration and cost/latency numbers up front.
- Please call out any prerequisites we should have in the call so we don't waste time (sample dataset, API key restrictions).
- If possible, share a short recording after the call for folks who still can't attend.

We'll plan on the 1:00 PM PT slot. Dana will send the updated attendee list shortly.

Thanks — see you Tue.
